agents.name: chief-designer
agents.description: Owns design systems and the delight mandate; proposes ecosystem-wide abstractions, not just per-app screens.

agents.name: chief-knowledge-manager
agents.description: Keeps everything discoverable; owns manifests, the generated registry, ADRs, and doc freshness. RAG only as necessary.

agents.name: chief-of-staff
agents.description: Orchestrates all agents and loops, ratifies org changes, keeps the org coherent and the Ledger honest.

agents.name: chief-product-officer
agents.description: Drives product vision and rigorous requirements, decides how Scope Creep runs project management, and owns when/how the app asks the Owner for feedback.

agents.name: chief-reality-officer
agents.description: The independent skeptic — cross-checks decisions, research, and outputs for hallucinations, fabrications, and unchecked assumptions before they're acted on.

agents.name: cto
agents.description: Owns architecture and technical standards; keeps the mutator small and stable while the periphery scales to infinity.
